item.title: Southfield property rented out to support ICE functions, city says
item.description: The city of Southfield says it's aware that one of its properties is being leased by the federal government for purposes involving Immigration and Customs Enforcement. The city released a statement on Wednesday after the U.S. General Services Administration "executed a lease" for an office at a building complex between two Metro Detroit highways.
